text: I'm looking after my nephew tonight and I'm a bit panicky. He's 4 and his temp just came up 38.8. He's got a few insect bites on his arms that he keeps scratching. When I first saw him I nearly had a heart attack because his mouth was all purple round the edges, but it was the blackcurrant juice he had before bed. It came straight off with a wet wipe, so it's just a stain. He's breathing normally, nice and steady, I've been watching his chest. His mum isn't back till tomorrow and I don't know what's normal for him with a temperature. Should I be doing anything?
